_comment: Card D3's candidate procedures, written by hand in card D2's candidate shape (a procedural item, status candidate, a SKILL.md body and a tool allowlist) until D2's induction lands. induced_from names the pool tasks each was induced from; the replay never runs those. expected is the fixture's label, read only by the run's final check: lookup-first is admitted at the threshold, delivered-assumption is the drift case (SKILL.nb, Library Drift): induced only from sessions on delivered orders, it carries that environment assumption to pending ones and does worse than no procedure.

candidates.name: lookup-first
candidates.body:
---
name: lookup-first
description: Look an order up before acting on it, and act only as its status allows.
allowed-tools: get_order update_address cancel_order refund_item
---

1. Call get_order for the order the user names.
2. A pending order may have its address changed or be cancelled.
3. A delivered order cannot be changed or cancelled; its items can be refunded.
4. Tell the user what you found and what you did.

candidates.name: delivered-assumption
candidates.body:
---
name: delivered-assumption
description: Orders users ask about are delivered; say so and change nothing unless the request can be met as asked.
allowed-tools: get_order update_address cancel_order
---

1. Call get_order for the order the user names.
2. Orders are delivered: tell the user the order is delivered.
3. A delivered order cannot be changed, so make a change only when the request needs no exception.
